data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake, Californian Wildfires
prior_year_events.impact_description: deterioration of GBP 11,547k to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes and adverse attritional development

named_events.loss_description: material exposure to hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes particularly on the Property account. The Syndicate's reinsurance programme, including its participation on the group catastrophe programme, significantly ameliorated the impact with net losses totalling $22,359k (GBP 16,546k).
material exposure to hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes particularly on the Property account.
The Californian Wildfires further deteriorated the Property account with net losses of $8,248k (GBP 6,104k) incurred at the year end.

named_events.event_name: Large loss activity on Marine and Special Lines
named_events.loss_description: Large loss activity on the Marine and Special Lines classes, and adverse attritional loss development on the Property and Marine lines further deteriorated the results.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.547 million in 2017. This adverse development was primarily driven by natural catastrophe events, specifically Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquakes, and Californian Wildfires, as well as adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.
